sectionHeadline: Repair it, or replace it properly.
about: Roofing Company of Houma, LLC handles roof repair and new roof installation in Houma. Whether a roof needs patching or replacing outright, we will look at what you have and tell you which makes sense. We work across the full range of roofing materials, from asphalt and architectural shingle through to wood shake, slate, tile and metal.
ctaCopy: Give us a call for roof repair or a new roof and we will get you a free quote.
footerLine: Roof repair and installation in Houma, Louisiana.
seoTitle: Roofing Company of Houma, LLC | Roofers in Houma, LA
seoDescription: Roof repair and new roof installation in Houma, Louisiana. Asphalt, architectural and wood shake shingle, slate, tile and metal roofing. Free quotes.

services.title: Roof repair
services.description: Repairs to an existing roof, from small damage through to the sort that needs attention before it gets worse.

services.title: Roof installation
services.description: Full installation of a new roof when repair is no longer the sensible option.

services.title: Asphalt and architectural shingle
services.description: The most common roofing choice, in standard asphalt or heavier architectural shingle.

services.title: Shake wood shingle
services.description: Wood shingles have been in use for hundreds of years and hold up in all weather, with good wind and impact resistance and useful insulating qualities.

services.title: Slate roofing
services.description: One of the most durable roofing materials there is, lasting fifty to a hundred years. Slate is expensive and fragile to work with, and its colour depends on where it was quarried.

services.title: Tile and metal roofing
services.description: Tile roofs, and metal roofing in its many forms — panels, standing seam, and metal tiles and shakes.
